name: Glendale Square
summary: Glendale Square is a 41,463 square foot neighborhood shopping center located in Everett, Massachusetts, just minutes from downtown Boston. Serving one of the region's most densely populated urban markets, the property provides convenient retail and services to over 1.8 million residents within a 10-mile radius.
demographics: Glendale Square serves a diverse urban population in Everett, Massachusetts, with strong proximity to downtown Boston. The trade area shows a median household income of $81,543 within 1 mile, increasing to $110,796 at 10 miles, indicating a working to middle-class demographic base. The center attracts approximately 61,384 residents within a 1-mile radius, expanding to over 1.8 million within 10 miles, with a significant daytime population of 2.4 million workers in the broader metro area. The demographic profile reflects typical urban Boston-area shoppers seeking convenient, everyday retail and services in a densely populated neighborhood setting.
description: Glendale Square is a compact urban shopping center strategically positioned at 317 Ferry Street in Everett, Massachusetts, offering convenient access to the greater Boston-Cambridge-Newton metropolitan area. Located in one of the most densely populated markets in the region, this 41,463 square foot property serves as a neighborhood retail hub for the diverse communities of Everett and surrounding areas. The center benefits from its proximity to downtown Boston, attracting both local residents and the substantial daytime workforce population that exceeds 2.4 million people within a 10-mile radius. Managed by Kimco Realty Corporation, one of North America's largest publicly traded owners and operators of open-air, grocery-anchored shopping centers, Glendale Square provides essential retail and service offerings tailored to urban shoppers. The property's location in the heart of Everett's commercial corridor makes it a particularly attractive destination for retailers seeking to capture the high-density urban market characteristic of the Boston metropolitan area.
